summary: Wired ArcPhase.social_event through _snapshot_from_phase() in generator.py into WorldSnapshot, added qualifying SocialEventSpec (confrontation on Day 7, withdrawal on Day 13) to two arc phases in arcs.py, and updated previously-None assertions in test_p32_t1_t4_live_audit.py and test_social_event_schema.py to reflect the new behavior, plus created new test file test_p32_t2_social_event_wire.py.
diff_summary: generator.py: added social_event=phase.social_event to WorldSnapshot constructor in _snapshot_from_phase(). arcs.py: added SocialEventType/SocialEventIntensity/SocialEventVisibility/SocialEventExpectedness/SocialEventReciprocity imports and added SocialEventSpec(event_type=confrontation) to Day 7 (Arc 1 Fringe Mutation) and SocialEventSpec(event_type=withdrawal) to Day 13 (Arc 2 Debate Splits). test_p32_t1_t4_live_audit.py: replaced always-None assertions with qualifying-day-aware assertions that allow Days in QUALIFYING_DAYS_IN_AUDIT={7} to have non-None social_event and T4 activation. test_social_event_schema.py: updated test_generator_produces_social_event_none to skip qualifying days 7 and 13. test_p32_t2_social_event_wire.py: new file with 4 test classes covering qualifying event presence, determinism, T4 activation rate > 0.0, and non-qualifying day None assertion.
